car.name: Saffron 135 2010
car.description: Original 2994 UK-style RHD three-door hatch referencing 2010 Fiat Punto Evo Sporting 1.4 MultiAir Turbo 135 five-speed manual. Exact trim selected for catalog, not an identification of a Forza screenshot. OEM SI anchors; gearbox reductions and unpublished dynamics are explicitly gameplay estimates.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: UK 2010 Fiat Punto Evo Sporting three-door 1.4 MultiAir Turbo 135, RHD, 5MT; not 105HP six-speed, Abarth, five-door or Dualogic

sources.access: Full UK release and technical tables read, 21 Jan 2010. Sporting price/equipment and 135 engine column selected. Five gears plus reverse explicitly listed. UK exact-trim values govern.

Original Fiat Spain technical sheet 18 Jan 2010; PDF page2 rendered and visually read. Corroborates 99kW/206Nm/1155kg three-door and five-speed Turbo135, distinct from six-speed105. Spanish tire alternatives/trim not substituted for UK Sporting.

verifiedFacts.massConvention: UK press kit DIN three-door kerb

gearingStatus.individualRatios: gameplay estimates; exact UK135 reductions not independently verified
gearingStatus.finalDrive: 3.563 gameplay estimate, NOT verified factory value
gearingStatus.rejectedEvidence: Other-market third-party JATO transcription has a different ratio set and C514 claim. No credible exact-UK-trim final-drive source established, so no source attribution is made for reductions.

estimates: UK prose/table calls135 bhp but SI column99kW and manufacturer Spanish135CV identify metric marketing horsepower; use99kW converted to132.76 mechanical hp.206Nm converted to lb-ft. Do not mistake marketing135 for SAE hp. Native editor serialization rounds scalar power/torque to133hp/152lb-ft; the authored curve retains the exact SI-converted anchors.

Five forward gears are verified. Individual forward ratios [3.909,2.158,1.480,1.121,.897], reverse3.818 and final3.563 are explicit gameplay estimates pending credible exact UK135 evidence, not transplanted as verified105/Abarth specs.
Auto Assist is gameplay automatic shifting of the modeled5MT, not a factory Dualogic/automatic. Manual remains selectable. Shift/clutch/launch times and87% efficiency are estimates.

Engine curve is modeled except206Nm at1750 and99kW at5000; idle800, redline6000 and limiter6500 are estimates.127mph is factory display target;8.2sec0-60 is estimated separately from sourced8.5sec0-62. Actual performance not calibrated.

Front weight63%, CG.52m, clearance.14m, overhangsplit, collider sections, steering15:1, drag.32, alignment/springs/brakes/aero, pressure33/30psi and grip are estimates. Nominal.30815m wheel radius derives from205/45R17, not loaded radius.
No implementation of factory MultiAir valve events, start-stop, Dualdrive City assistance or hill-holder logic. Shared existing FWD simulation and open-differential approximation.

Original ochre/plum2994 three-door exterior and RHD dashboard; no badges/livery. Mark identified a Punto in Forza Motorsport4, but this exact trim is our documented catalog choice, not a verified screenshot identification.
